'''0.21b''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that decreased hipfire accuracy and fixed an error with armor modifiers.

==Changelog==
===Renaissance Army===
* [[AKM]] Damage reduced to 45

===Gameplay===
* Fixed crash during selection of the matches
* Fixed a bug with the work of modifiers to increase armour and damage reduction. Now they work not only on the body armour, but also on other subjects
* Reinforced marksmanship skill. To compensate for the increased influence of the skill we increased spread when firing from the hip
* Altered outcome of matches when both teams score 0. Now it is no longer a victory for both teams
* Fixed a bug in the calculation of awards for the match

===User Interface===
* Fixed match statistics window
* Reduced the number of false positives filter mat
* Fixed incorrect match-making of players
* Changed the identifier on the subject from having additional features
